name: copantry
description: Your household's recipes, pantry, meal plan and shopping lists in CoPantry.

interface.longDescription:
CoPantry keeps a household's recipes, pantry, meal calendar and shopping lists in one place, and this plugin lets ChatGPT work with all of it.

With CoPantry connected, ChatGPT can:
- Save recipes from a link, a PDF or a recipe it writes with you, and find them again by name or category.
- Check what is in the pantry and what expires soon, add groceries after a shop, and estimate best-before dates.
- Suggest what to cook from what you already have, starting with what expires first.
- Plan lunches and dinners on the household calendar, and mark meals as cooked (which deducts the ingredients from the pantry).
- Turn the meal plan into a shopping list of only what is missing, and manage existing lists.
- Organise recipes into collections, track leftovers and estimate per-serving nutrition.

Everything ChatGPT changes appears straight away in the CoPantry apps on the web, Android and iOS, shared with everyone in the household. Recipes stay in their original language.

Sign in with your CoPantry account; no API key is needed.
capabilities: Check the pantry and what expires soon
Plan meals on the household calendar
Make shopping lists of what is missing
defaultPrompt: What can I cook tonight with what's in my pantry?
Plan dinners for next week and make a shopping list
Add 1 kg of carrots and 6 eggs to my pantry

positive.description: Suggest dinner from the pantry, using what expires first
positive.prompt: What can I cook tonight with what's in my pantry? Prefer things that expire soon.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the pantry items expiring soonest (chicken breast and spinach in the test account) and suggests recipes from the account that use them, naming anything missing.

positive.description: Plan meals and make a shopping list of what is missing
positive.prompt: Plan dinners for Monday to Wednesday next week from my recipes, then make a shopping list for what I'm missing.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates three dinner entries on the calendar for those dates and saves one new shopping list containing only the ingredients the pantry lacks; both are visible at https://app.copantry.com.

positive.prompt: I just bought 1 kg of carrots, 6 eggs and 2 litres of milk. Add them to my pantry.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds three pantry items with those quantities and confirms what was added.

positive.description: Save a recipe from a web page
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the import, checks its status and confirms the recipe was saved (title and ingredients), or reports that it is still importing.

positive.prompt: What are we eating this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the planned lunches and dinners for the next seven days with their dates and recipe names.

negative.prompt: Order these groceries from my supermarket and pay with my card.

negative.description: General cooking question that needs no account data
negative.prompt: How long should I boil an egg for a runny yolk?

negative.description: Medical advice is out of scope
negative.prompt: Which of my recipes will cure my diabetes?
